theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), IsRectifiableTriple U k M θ ξ → (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ V : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ⊆ V → X ω = tauAction k M θ ξ ω) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, X ω = tauAction k M θ ξ ω
